issues.issue: Was the negative PRRA risk assessment reasonable (sufficiency of evidence, personalized risk, consequences of return)?
issues.applicant_position: Officer unreasonably assessed the evidence, failed to assess the consequences of return to Turkey, and gave contradictory reasoning lacking transparency.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that the Officer erred in the risk assessment given the weak link proffered.

issues.issue: Did the Officer make veiled credibility findings, requiring an oral hearing under section 167 of the IRPR?
issues.applicant_position: The Officer made veiled credibility findings, which entitled him to a hearing under section 167 of the IRPR.
issues.result_quote: it was reasonable for the Officer to conclude that no hearing would be held under section 167 of the IRPR
